questions.question: Identify the correct statement about Neel Bidroha or the Indigo Revolt.
options: Indigo cultivation was practiced mainly in two forms, the Nij-abad and the Ryoti.
In the Ryoti cultivation, the planter produced indigo on lands that he directly controlled.
Indigo was being cultivated in Bihar since the end of the 18th century.
Neel Bidroha or the Indigo Revolt started in 1861.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Indigo cultivation was practiced mainly in two forms, the Nij-abad and the Ryoti.) है।

questions.question: The Kerala Official Language (Legislation) Act of ______ provides for the adoption of Malayalam and English as the languages to be used for official purposes of the State of Kerala.
Select the correct statement about the Census of India.
options: The responsibility of conducting the Decadal Census rests with the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
The Indian Census is the only source of various statistical information on various characteristics of the people of India.
The Census Act was enacted in the year 1950 to provide a plan for conducting population census along with the duties and responsibilities of census officers.
The first Census was conducted non-synchronously in different parts of India in 1870.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The responsibility of conducting the Decadal Census rests with the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.) है।
